hero.name: MARCELO PIRES DE FARIAS

about.label: 01 / ABOUT
about.paragraph1: My career brings together technology, management, and experience in environments where systems need to work in the real world. Over the years, I have built solutions to simplify processes, automate workflows, and turn operational challenges into practical digital products.
about.paragraph2: Today, my work focuses on software development, artificial intelligence, automation, and digital transformation — always pursuing solutions that deliver measurable impact and make sense for the people who actually use them.

projects.label: 02 / PROJECTS
projects.intro: Solutions shaped by concrete needs, combining software, automation, artificial intelligence, and operational experience.

hefesto.name: HEPHAESTUS
hefesto.description: A platform built to optimize emergency call handling and incident creation for 190/193 operations, combining automation, data, and operational intelligence in a mission-critical environment.

experience.label: 03 / EXPERIENCE
experience.intro: My professional journey has been shaped by technology, management, and operational experience. That combination gave me a perspective I consider essential: understanding the problem before building the solution.
experience.closingLine1: Technology has changed over the years.

formation.title: TECHNOLOGY FOUNDATION
formation.text: A degree in Information Systems established the technical foundation for a career focused on software development, process analysis, and practical applications of technology.

processes.title: TECHNOLOGY APPLIED TO PROCESSES
processes.text: Experience with administrative processes led to the creation of systems to digitize workflows, organize information, and replace manual controls with more efficient solutions.

operations.title: TECHNOLOGY IN CRITICAL OPERATIONS
operations.text: My work expanded into systems used in high-demand operational environments, bringing software development, automation, and real user needs even closer together.

today.title: SOFTWARE, AI & AUTOMATION
today.text: Today, I focus on building systems, automations, and AI-powered solutions, combining operational experience, software architecture, and a strong focus on efficiency.
